pages.text: Two compact stars spiral in as gravitational waves carry off their orbit; how fast the pitch rises depends only on the $(thing)chirp mass$() (m₁m₂)^(3/5)/(m₁ + m₂)^(1/5). The Binary of the Accretion Frontier drops Chirp Signal Records and Merger Remnants.

The Laser Interferometer, listening to a chirp with a strain sensor, can hear a $(item)Gravitational Wave Echo$() - repeats after the ringdown, if a horizon is not quite a horizon. Played in the Frontier, an echo summons The Binary just as a Binary Black Hole Merger record does.
